claims.statement: DoD's seven pillars are identical to CISA's — the difference is implementation depth
claims.evidence_excerpt: These seven pillars are identical to CISA's five-pillar model (CISA groups Network, Applications & Workload, and Data under a broader "Network/Environment" category but organizes maturity assessments around the same seven areas). The DoD adds specific defense-relevant technologies: Comply-to-Connect (C2C), PKI/CAC, JRSS, and explicit DevSecOps integration for the Applications pillar.

claims.evidence_excerpt:
